title: FileGator
descript: FileGator is a self-hosted file manager for your NAS. Browse folders in the browser, create folders or empty files, upload and download, rename, copy, move, delete, zip and unzip, change permissions and edit text files. Multi-user with admin, user and guest roles, a per-account home directory and read/write/upload/download/zip permissions. Files and account data stay in the application data folder.
release_note: 7.16.9-3: remediation of the listing review - (1) a first-start wrapper now creates private/logs and private/users.json, so the web UI opens on a fresh install (before: 'Folder not writable: /private/logs/'), and the default login is documented correctly as admin/admin123; (2) privacy policy PRIVACY.md (retention, user rights, security, third-party disclosure), duplicate official key removed from config.ini, README/NOTICE for repository compliance, description corrected to the features 7.16.9 really ships (no share links, no S3/WebDAV adapter), 23 locales re-rendered. Same official image (v7.16.9, latest stable 7.x) and same port 8063.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The first login is admin/admin123 - change it immediately. Files live in DockerAppData/filegatordocker/repository, accounts and the login log in .../private. Plain HTTP: use a TLS reverse proxy or a VPN before exposing it to the internet. This version has no share links and no S3/WebDAV storage adapter. See PRIVACY.md for data handling.

zh-cn.descript: FileGator 是自建的 NAS 文件管理器：在浏览器里浏览目录、新建文件夹或空文件、上传下载、重命名、复制、移动、删除、压缩解压、修改权限、编辑文本文件。支持多用户（admin/user/guest 角色，可设各自的主目录与读/写/上传/下载/压缩权限）。文件与账户数据都保存在应用数据目录中。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。首次登录为 admin/admin123，请立即修改。文件在 DockerAppData/filegatordocker/repository，账户与登录日志在 .../private。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置 TLS 反向代理或 VPN。本版本不含分享链接，也不含 S3/WebDAV 存储适配。数据细节见 PRIVACY.md。

zh-hk.descript: FileGator 是自建的 NAS 檔案管理器：在瀏覽器裡瀏覽目錄、新增資料夾或空檔案、上傳下載、重新命名、複製、移動、刪除、壓縮解壓、修改權限、編輯文字檔案。支援多使用者（admin/user/guest 角色，可設各自的主目錄與讀/寫/上傳/下載/壓縮權限）。檔案與帳戶資料都保存在應用資料目錄中。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。首次登入為 admin/admin123，請立即修改。檔案在 DockerAppData/filegatordocker/repository，帳戶與登入日誌在 .../private。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置 TLS 反向代理或 VPN。本版本不含分享連結，也不含 S3/WebDAV 儲存適配。資料細節見 PRIVACY.md。

data_notes: `repository/` (mounted from `DockerAppData/filegatordocker/repository`) holds the files users see; `private/` (mounted from `.../private`) holds `users.json` (accounts, roles, ACL and bcrypt password hashes), `logs/app.log` (login events) and `tmp/` (1 MB upload chunks and zip staging, garbage-collected after 2 days).
design_notes: **Runs as uid 1000.** The image's `www-data` is uid 33, so the package pins uid 1000 explicitly and the TOS installer hands both mounted folders to that user; Apache's runtime and log directories in the image are world-writable, which is why a non-root start works.
**No database.** Users, roles and permissions are a single JSON file; files live on disk.

**The image is unmodified.** The only wrapper is `src/entrypoint.sh`, which seeds the two data folders that the bind mounts hide on a fresh install and then execs the image's own `docker-php-entrypoint apache2-foreground`. It never modifies files of the image and never overwrites an existing `users.json`.
limitations: - The default admin/admin123 login must be changed on first visit.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy or a VPN before exposing it to the internet.
- No share links and no S3/WebDAV/SFTP storage adapter in this version (the image is hard-configured for local storage).
- aarch64 is not supported: the upstream `filegator/filegator:v7.16.9` image is linux/amd64 only (its OCI index has no linux/arm64 manifest). See README.md.
- Uploads are chunked at 1 MB; PHP keeps upload_max_filesize=2M / post_max_size=8M, so a non-chunked request above 8 MB is refused.
